text.p: Following is the planned timetable for the summit between U.S. President Bill Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin, which ends on Friday.

The meeting in the Finnish capital started one day later than planned, over dinner on Thursday, because Clinton had to undergo surgery following a knee injury last week. The main talks take place on Friday.
All times given are local, followed by GMT.
1000/0800 GMT - Ahtisaari greets both presidents at his secluded residence, Mantyniemi, and leaves them to their talks. The house is on a promontory overlooking the Baltic.
1845/1645 GMT - A news conference is planned at the nearby Kalastajatorppa Hotel, close to the summit site.
0930/0730 GMT - Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov and Finnish Foreign Minister Tarja Halonen give news conference.
Yeltsin and Ahtisaari have bilateral talks over lunch at Presidential Palace. A news conference is planned to follow.
